title: The Missing Person
briefing_md:
Ananya Desai, lead actress of the college drama society, vanished on Friday night, 20 hours before the final show of “Midnight in Jaipur”.

Rehearsal ended at 9:00 PM. A note on her dressing-room mirror says she left on her own. Her friends do not believe it.

Three people are being talked about:
• Dev Malhotra, 23, the stage manager and Ananya's ex. He argued with her on Thursday.
• Kavya Nair, 21, the understudy. She says she left around 8:45 PM and has not spoken to Ananya since rehearsal.
• Mr. Sandeep Rao, 50, the director. He scolded Ananya in front of everyone last week.

Most people suspect Dev. What happened to Ananya, where is she, and who is responsible?

clue.label: Her bag
clue.title: Left in the dressing room
clue.text: Ananya's bag is still in the dressing room. Inside: her wallet, hostel ID, room keys and phone charger. Her phone is not there.

questions.question: The note says she left on her own. What does the bag say?
options: She planned the trip carefully and chose to travel light
She did not expect to be gone: what she would need is still here
She walked back to her hostel room straight after rehearsal
She was robbed in the dressing room before she had a chance to leave

clue.label: Mirror note
clue.title: The note and her notebook
clue.text:
• The note on the mirror is written with a blue gel pen.
• Ananya's notebook is written with a black fountain pen from the first page to the last.

questions.question: How strong is this clue on its own?
options: It proves that somebody else wrote the note
It proves Ananya was hiding her handwriting
It means nothing at all, because anyone can borrow a pen for a minute
It is a hint that needs a second sign to back it up

clue.label: Spelling
clue.title: Read the note closely
clue.text:
The note says: “I can't do this anymore. I will definately not be back. Don't look for me.”

In Ananya's notebook the spelling is correct everywhere. She writes “definitely” correctly, twice.

questions.question: Now add the spelling to the pen. What do the two show together?
options: Ananya wrote the note herself, in a great hurry
The note is a line copied out of the script of the play they are staging
Two separate habits of the writer are not Ananya's habits
The note was certainly written by Dev

clue.label: Light console
clue.title: Where was Dev?
clue.text:
• Ananya was last seen leaving the stage at 9:05 PM.
• Stage crew: “Dev was at the light console, in full view of all of us, from 9:00 to 10:30.”
• Ananya's phone record shows 3 missed calls from Dev between 9:20 and 9:35 PM.
• Dev raised the alarm at 10:00 PM.

questions.question: Could Dev have taken Ananya anywhere after 9:05 PM?
options: Yes: he had time between his phone calls to her
No: the whole crew had him in view until 10:30
Yes: he raised the alarm only to cover himself
No: because he phoned her three times

clue.label: Thursday
clue.title: The argument everyone talks about
clue.text:
• A poster of last year's show still hangs backstage, showing Dev and Ananya together; they were a couple then.
• Crew member: “On Thursday they argued about a lighting cue. On Friday they rehearsed that scene together and it went fine.”

questions.question: Most people suspect Dev. How strong is the case against him?
options: A reason to look at him, but it is weak and nothing places him with her
Strong: an ex who argued with her is the obvious answer
Strong: the poster shows he had not got over her
None at all: people who work together never fall out

clue.label: Gate register
clue.title: The director
clue.text:
• Main gate register: the director's car went out at 9:15 PM.
• The director: “If Ananya cannot perform, my final show is in trouble. I need her on that stage.”

questions.question: Which two things together make the director unlikely?
options: He was at the light console all evening, and he has no key to any room
He scolded her last week, and he owns a car
He has directed for years, and he was seen at rehearsal
He left the campus at 9:15, and he loses most if she is gone

clue.label: Understudy
clue.title: Who gains?
clue.text: The director: “Kavya wants the lead badly. If Ananya cannot perform tomorrow, the role goes to her.”

questions.question: This gives Kavya a motive, nothing more. What should be checked next?
options: Whether her statement about leaving at 8:45 PM is true
Whether she knows all of the lead role's lines
Whether she and Dev are friends outside rehearsal
Whether the director has promised her the lead role in an earlier show

clue.label: Janitor
clue.title: Mr. Pillai's statement
clue.text: “Around 9:40 PM I heard faint knocking from the basement. I thought it was the pipes.”

questions.question: Put this beside the bag she left behind. What should the searchers do first?
options: Check the railway station and the bus stand
Phone her parents and wait for her to turn up
Search the basement rooms straight away
Call a plumber to look at the pipes

twist_md: New evidence has come in: Ananya's phone has been unlocked, and the stage key board and the gate register have been checked.

clue.label: Her phone
clue.title: Last message received
clue.text:
9:08 PM, from Kavya:
“Your cloak got moved to the old store room. Come, I'll open it.”

Kavya's statement: “I left around 8:45 PM. I haven't spoken to Ananya since rehearsal.”
Main gate register: Kavya Nair — OUT 10:20 PM.

twist_questions.question: How much of Kavya's statement is now shown to be false?
options: None of it: the message could be about another day
One part: only the time she left
Both parts: when she left, and that she had no contact with Ananya
We cannot say without hearing from Dev

clue.label: Key board
clue.title: Keys and the basement door
clue.text:
• On the stage key board, the tag for B-07 (the old costume store room in the basement) is missing.
• Door B-07 has old rusted hinges, but a brand-new shiny padlock.

twist_questions.question: Why does the new padlock matter?
options: Old store rooms are fitted with new locks every term
Someone locked that room very recently, and the knocking came from the basement
It shows the janitor has not been doing his rounds
It shows Ananya shut herself in to get away from the show

clue.label: Kavya's script
clue.title: Notes in the margin
clue.text:
Kavya's copy of the script has notes in blue gel pen.
In one note she writes: “definately louder here”.

twist_questions.question: Which two earlier clues does Kavya's script match?
options: The pen and the misspelling in the mirror note
The bag, the wallet and the phone charger left behind
The old poster and Thursday's argument
The gate register and the director's car

answer.explanation: Kavya Nair, the understudy, lured Ananya to the old costume store room B-07 with a message at 9:08 PM, locked her in with a new padlock and wrote a fake goodbye note on the mirror. The note is in Kavya's blue gel pen with her spelling mistake “definately”; Ananya uses a black fountain pen and spells the word correctly. Ananya's wallet, ID, keys and charger were left behind, and the janitor heard knocking from the basement at 9:40. Kavya said she left at 8:45 and had no contact, but she messaged Ananya at 9:08 and the gate register shows 10:20. If Ananya cannot perform, the lead goes to Kavya. Dev was at the light console in view of the crew from 9:00 and kept calling her; the director left at 9:15. Ananya is found safe in B-07.
